title: *EDU401 - GDB Solution*
text:
*EDU401 - GDB Solution*

*My Choice: Collaborating Style*

In my opinion, the *Collaborating* style from TKI works best in a Pakistani school.

*Why?*

*1. Win-Win Solution:* Collaborating focuses on finding a solution where both parties are satisfied. In a school, whether conflict is between teacher-student or teacher-teacher, this keeps the learning environment positive instead of creating winners and losers.

*2. Maintains Relationships and Respect:* Pakistani culture values respect, especially for teachers and elders. Collaborating allows open discussion with respect, so relationships are not damaged like in the Competing style.

*3. Long-Term and Effective:* Avoiding only delays the problem and Accommodating suppresses one side. Collaborating solves the root cause of the conflict, builds trust, teamwork and improves discipline and academic environment in the long run.

*Conclusion:* Although Compromising can be useful when time is short, Collaborating is the most effective style for Pakistani schools because it balances both task and relationship.
